value.deliverable: a TRANSLATION, not a replacement; translation is not deference

steps.what: the entry format: four mandatory parts (checked substrate <-> cited physics), and the four-parts validator
steps.why: an ENTRY pairs a CHECKED substrate-side object with a CITED standing physics result, each declaring what does NOT travel, each falsifiable by an outside reader who computes both sides and disagrees. FOUR parts, all mandatory and non-empty -- WHAT-DOES-NOT-TRAVEL especially (Kelvin and miles do not convert; an entry that carries everything across is a unification claim, which this project is not making). Two KINDS: a CORRESPONDENCE builds the common language (what the project OWES); a RESOLUTION states, in that language, a fix to a problem physics records as open (what it is FOR) -- and a correspondence must NOT be written as a resolution. The four_parts_ok validator is mechanical and passes on the worked entry (E.4).

steps.check: no DERIVED step rests on a quarantined reading (scan passes); substrate bar holds
steps.determines: UNIQUE (the quarantine holds or names its violation)
steps.expr: for every DERIVED step in every container, no dependency (frm) is a quarantined reading (downstream_premise_use=False, or a Stone's non-DERIVED step)

value.rule: AN ENTRY IS NEVER A PREMISE; no DERIVED result rests on a quarantined reading

steps.what: the quarantine, mechanical: no DERIVED result rests on a quarantined physics reading
steps.why: THE RULE THE FORMAT RESTS ON, as a graph query run every time verify.py runs this container. A QUARANTINED READING is a physics reading held as a possibility -- a POSTULATE/OWED step marked downstream_premise_use=False (the named possibilities 15.C.3, 16.D.3), or any non-DERIVED step of a QUARANTINED Stone (17.S.3/4/5, 18.P.3/4). The check VERIFIES that NO DERIVED step anywhere lists one in its dependencies -- every DERIVED result rests only on DERIVED/checked things. This is the STONE rule generalised (read, never import): if the physics were abandoned tomorrow, nothing DERIVED would move. It PASSES now across all built containers. Plus the SUBSTRATE BAR: the worked entry's substrate side (14.B.4) resolves to a DERIVED (checked) step -- an entry may not pair a citation with a guess.

steps.check: the worked entry passes all six admission tests (with honest notes)
steps.determines: UNIQUE (six tests; the worked entry passes all)
steps.expr: renaming . cannot-fail . import . fit . tier . observer-rank; a candidate failing ANY is not an entry

1_renaming.note: a reader computes the Regge deficit from the substrate degree on ANY mesh, and the permanence (Sum=12*chi) from the substrate's own refinement -- predictive, not a bare relabel.

2_cannot_fail.note: the non-trivial content is the PERMANENCE: the total is 12*chi and refinement-INVARIANT. A substrate whose deficit failed to sum to 2*pi*chi, or drifted under refinement, would refute -- state that refuter first. (The bare angle formula 2pi-d*pi/3 is near-definitional; the conservation is the content, exactly as maths-4 DEFECT-PERMANENCE.)

3_import.note: no checked proof uses Regge; 14.B.4 is derived from the registration/closure combinatorics (Gauss-Bonnet), zero-axiom. Regge is cited as the correspondence, never as machinery -- the IMPORT test, which E.2 also enforces.

4_fit.note: no free parameter, no fitted number; 12*chi = 24 falls out of the closed triangulation (chi=2), not chosen to match.

5_tier.note: named: SURFACE (the closed triangulated 2-sphere / the twelve). A pairing across mismatched tiers is the project's most-repeated error; named here.

6_observer_rank.note: ported placeholder: the substrate object is a per-vertex integer count (constitution) read as an angle deficit (reading). Named, not inferred one-from-the-other. (The full maths-4 two-axis test is not re-built.)

steps.what: the six admission tests -- the gate (applied to the worked entry)
steps.why: the genre fails predictably; each failure mode becomes a test a candidate must pass BEFORE it is written. 1 RENAMING (compute one side from the other, not relabel -- a name is not a translation). 2 CANNOT-FAIL (could it have come out false? state the refuter -- an identity true by algebra explains nothing). 3 IMPORT (no checked proof uses the physics side -- physics is a stone to translate against, never machinery; E.2 enforces this mechanically). 4 FIT (no free or fitted parameter). 5 TIER (name the substrate tier; cross-tier pairing is the repeated error). 6 OBSERVER-RANK (name it; ported placeholder). The worked entry is run through all six and passes, with honest notes (its cannot-fail content is the PERMANENCE, not the near-definitional angle formula). A candidate failing any is NOT filed as a weaker entry -- it is not an entry.

steps.determines: POSTULATE (a correspondence reading; illustration; never a premise)
steps.expr: SUBSTRATE 14.B.4 (12*chi, checked) <-> PHYSICS Regge delta=2pi-d*pi/3, Sum=2pi*chi (cited); does-not-travel: the Regge action/continuum/Einstein eqs

value.does_not_travel: the Regge ACTION, its continuum limit, and the Einstein equations it approximates -- NOT imported, NOT implied, and must not be cited from here. The substrate derived its deficit from its own registration/closure combinatorics; the correspondence is a CHECK on that, not a supply line.
value.falsifies_by: an outside reader computes the substrate's per-vertex deficit (14.B.4, on ANY refinement mesh) and the Regge deficit angle on the SAME mesh; a disagreement is a nonzero difference in radits at some vertex. On ANY mesh -- not one example.
value.grade_note: an entry is ASSERTED/held -- the pairing is a reading, not a proof
value.name: ENTRY-density-deficit-is-Regge
value.physics_side: Regge calculus: a vertex carries deficit angle delta = 2*pi - (sum of incident corner angles); for an equilateral triangulation delta = 2*pi - d*pi/3, and Sum(delta) = 2*pi*chi (Gauss-Bonnet). CITED, not re-derived.
value.substrate_side: 14-density-deficit B.4 -- the angle-deficit charge Sum(12-2d) = 12*chi = 24 (the twelve carry 2 radits each, refinement-invariant). CHECKED (DERIVED, zero-axiom).

steps.what: worked entry (ILLUSTRATION, not filed): the angle-deficit (14.B.4) <-> Regge deficit
steps.why: the worked CORRESPONDENCE entry, cast in the four-part format to show the shape and to give E.1-E.3 something to range over -- ILLUSTRATION only, NOT a filed physical claim, and (like every entry) NEVER a premise (downstream_premise_use=False). SUBSTRATE SIDE: container 14.B.4, the angle-deficit charge Sum(12-2d) = 12*chi = 24, refinement-invariant, CHECKED (DERIVED, zero-axiom). PHYSICS SIDE: Regge calculus' deficit angle delta = 2*pi - d*pi/3 with Sum(delta) = 2*pi*chi, CITED not re-derived. DOES NOT TRAVEL: the Regge action, its continuum limit, the Einstein equations -- not imported, not implied. FALSIFIES BY: compute both per-vertex deficits on ANY mesh and find disagreement. It is a CORRESPONDENCE (the common language), NOT a resolution (it closes no open physics problem). Held as a reading -- what the Lean proves is proved, what it is ABOUT is asserted.
